messages:
Alex Jensen: Quick vendor tie-out: Google + Azure marketplace + SI partners — need to lock H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi readiness windows. Targeting coordinated announce wave Oct 12-26. Who's owning marketplace listing assets & embargoes?
Maria G: @Alex Jensen noted — Google has strict pre-announce embargo: they'd want assets 10 days prior. Azure wants 7 days. Can we compress? :thinking_face:
Samir K: Build images + cert tags needed: `redwood-prod:v2026-10-h100` and `redwood-prod:v2026-10-mi300` — CI is green for h100 but MI300 quantization still flaky. ETA fix: 4 days.
Kevin P: lab capacity is tight that week. We can reserve 6 H100 slots and 4 MI300, but B200/Gaudi availability depends on vendor lab schedule. Need priority order.
Elaine C: I'll own Google contact (gcp-partner@google). @Maria G I'll confirm exact embargo window. Also need GCP marketplace deploy package: `gcp_deploy.yaml` + compliance attestation.
Alex Jensen: owners: marketplace assets -> Elaine, SI integration test -> Samir, embargo coordination -> Maria. Can ops create meeting with vendor liaisons?
ops-bot: Meeting created: Vendor Tieout — cross-cloud marketplace — Thu Oct 1 10:00PT. Invitees: Alex Jensen, Maria G, Samir K, Kevin P, Elaine C, gcp-partner, az-marketplace. (link) :calendar: 
Samir K: Quick check — to enable private deployment images we need KMS integration test. Sample doc snippet I pushed to workspace:
```yaml
kms:
  provider: aws-kms
  key_alias: alias/redwood-prod
marketplace:
  listing_type: SaaS
  images:
    - redwood-prod:v2026-10-h100
    - redwood-prod:v2026-10-mi300
```
Kevin P: FYI vendor asked for power/thermal numbers for H200 rack. I've attached short note in Drive: (link).
Maria G: Also PR day-of embargo window: no press until 12:00PT Oct 12. We should avoid overlapping marketplace availability on Oct 12 morning.
Alex Jensen: Proposal: stagger marketplace live windows per vendor: Google Oct 12 12:00PT, Azure Oct 14 09:00PT, SI launch dates Oct 19-23. Agreed?
Elaine C: Agreed. I'll draft the asset checklist: logos, lab images, kernel tags, compliance CSV, bench numbers, 1-liner PR blurb. Will share by EOD Wed.
Samir K: I'll add a smoke test matrix for SI: basic inference, KV cache correctness, quantized model parity, embedding quality check.
gcp-partner: (external) thanks Alex — we'll validate listing metadata; need final binaries 7 days prior for review.
az-marketplace: (external) can we get an earlier review window? 10/6 would be ideal.
Alex Jensen: Noted. Maria, can you negotiate Google to accept 7-day preview for Redwood strategic partners?
Maria G: On it. pinging @gcp-partner.
ops-bot: Reminder: please add all marketplace assets to shared folder: /shared/partnerships/vendor-tieout/1880012345
Alex Jensen: If any blockers, flag them here. Need a go/no-go by Oct 3 COB for our marketing calendar.
